newsitem.title: USA: Spiegel issues 10.3 mln Class B shares.
newsitem.headline: Spiegel issues 10.3 mln Class B shares.

text.p: Spiegel Inc said Friday it will use $70 million in proceeds from issuance of 10.3 million shares of Class B voting common stock to fund capital needs, including the continued expansion of its Eddie Bauer subsidiary.

The specialty retailer's plans call for it to open up to 70 Eddie Bauer stores in North America in 1997 and double the number of Eddie Bauer Sportswear stores in North America over the next five years. In total, Eddie Bauer currently operates 443 retail stores throughout the United States and Canada, including 348 Eddie Bauer Sportswear stores.
Spiegel said prior to issuance of the 10.3 million Class B shares, it had 93.1 million such shares and 14.6 million Class A shares.
The company now said it has about 118.1 million shares outstanding.
